description.value: Wildeye Brewing is a craft brewery and taproom on the North Shore, a short ride from the Iron Workers Memorial Bridge cycling corridor. The house lineup spans award-winning Czech Pilsner, hazy IPAs, sours, and stouts, alongside an entirely non-alcoholic Easy Series for riders staying dry. The taproom hosts regular live music and trivia nights, offers a full bistro menu, and can accommodate private events for up to 75 guests.
